subject: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization
body:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: People Ops <peopleops@acme-enterprise.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization

Hi People Ops / Anita,

Following Sam's resignation yesterday, we have an immediate on-call gap for the SRE rotation on critical infra. I know we have a hiring freeze in place, but this is a production-facing service with a documented SLO impact risk if we don't backfill quickly.

Summary: 
- Role: Senior SRE (IC4 equivalent) — will own on-call rotation + infra incidents for Redis/cache layer.
- Impact if unfilled: elevated incident response times, increased MTTR risk for customer-facing latency regressions.
- Proposed mitigation: short-term contractor for 8–12 weeks to cover on-call + runbook updates, concurrently open a permanent reposting for a full-time SRE.

Asks: 
1) Approval for a hiring-freeze exception to open a backfill req (1 FTE) for the SRE role.
2) If headcount cannot be approved, permission to engage a contract (talent agency) up to $45k for 12 weeks charged to infra cost center 430-OPS.
3) A fast-track review; we need an answer by end of day Friday to avoid gaps next week.

I've attached a short term summary (SRE-term-summary.pdf) and the proposed hiring plan with cost breakdown (proposed-hiring-plan.xlsx). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSRE-HiringPlan

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com; peopleops@acme-enterprise.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization

Jonas — thanks for the context and for the quick packet. I'm strongly supportive of a freeze exception here. A few data points from my side:

- Sam has been the primary for Redis incidents for 18 months; the secondary has limited experience and is already at 80% capacity on Feature X rollout support.
- Cost comparison: contractor + knowledge transfer (est. $35–45k) vs. hiring lead time (~10–12 weeks) and potential overspend on incidents if we delay.
- Risk: two incident-prone weeks during holiday coverage window in July.

Recommendation: Approve the freeze exception for 1 FTE with a parallel contractor engagement to bridge until the perm hire starts. If People Ops needs an exact cost center code, use 430-OPS.

Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Jun 18, 2026 at 09:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message omitted)

-----Original Message-----
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization

+1 to approving a mitigation plan. A couple of constraints from product/roadmap: 
- We can offer reallocated headcount from the 'infra automation' initiative (we were planning 0.6 FTE this quarter) to expedite approval for the short term.
- I want a short 'canary' plan: contractor cannot be given escalation-only privileges until week 2, we need at least one knowledge-transfer session recorded.

If People Ops approves the exception, I will sign off on the requisition and the cost reallocation.

Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: People Ops <peopleops@acme-enterprise.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, Anita Rao <anita.rao@talentbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the packet and the clear ask. We can route an exception for critical operational roles; please note the following requirements to complete approval:

1) Signed headcount-exception form (attached template) with cost center and stakeholder signoffs.
2) Formal requisition in Greenhouse with the hiring manager noted as Jonas Weber.
3) If you choose contractor route, a contractor engagement form and PO are required.

Next steps: 
- We will kick off a 24-hour expedited review once we receive the signed exception form and the Greenhouse requisition ID.
- DocuSign link for the exception form: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/ABC123456789

Cc'ing Anita from TalentBridge if you want immediate contractor candidates.

Best,
People Ops Team
peopleops@acme-enterprise.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@talentbridge.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, peopleops@acme-enterprise.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization

Jonas — good morning. I pulled three candidates that match the Senior SRE spec and can place someone with 48–72 hour notice for a contractor engagement. Attached is a short candidate summary (sent separately). Typical bill rate would be $150–180/hr; for a 12-week engagement that maps to roughly $32k–40k.

If you prefer a perm hire, we can accelerate sourcing but the earliest start will be ~10 weeks including notice periods. Let me know whether you want contractor-only or contractor + perm pipeline.

Cheers,
Anita Rao
Engagement Lead, TalentBridge
anita.rao@talentbridge.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: People Ops <peopleops@acme-enterprise.com>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@talentbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount gap mitigation: interim SRE coverage & permanent hire authorization

Quick update: People Ops approved an expedited review. I completed the DocuSign exception form (signed-exception-form.pdf attached) and submitted the Greenhouse req (ID: GH-57821). Markus agreed to reallocate 0.6 FTE from infra automation this quarter.

Decision: Approve contractor engagement to start Monday for immediate coverage; continue with permanent req GH-57821 in parallel. Anita, please proceed with candidate placement; Laura — please start the req intake and confirm onboarding checklist.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Jonas
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: signed-exception-form.pdf; SRE-term-summary.pdf; proposed-hiring-plan.xlsx
